title: Guo's Entry Tear Repair :The First in Man Study of Endopatch System
brief_summary: A prospective, single-center, first in man study to evaluate the safety and efficacy of Endopatch System manufactured by Hangzhou Endonom Medtech Co., Ltd. for the Chronic Stanford B type aortic dissection proximal tear.
condition: Chronic Stanford B Type Aortic Dissection Proximal Tear
